title: Simple Flower Applique
description: A five-petal flower motif for learning repeated shaping around a center.
expectationText: A cheerful motif that repeats the same petal sequence so shaping starts to feel predictable.

steps.title: Make the center
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring and work 10 single crochet into the center.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Join the center round with a slip stitch and tighten the ring.

steps.title: Make five petals
steps.instruction: Repeat chain stitches and double crochet into the same stitch to form each petal.

steps.title: Shape the petals
steps.instruction: Gently tug each petal into place so the flower sits flat.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off and weave tails into the back of the flower.
